title: GTA 6 Midnight Launch Plans Have Fans Eyeing New Zealand
description: Rockstar is launching GTA 6 at midnight local time on November 19, and fans are already planning to change their console regions to New Zealand to play early.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## The Anticipation for GTA 6 Digital Launch

As the gaming world counts down to the release of Grand Theft Auto 6, details regarding how and when players can jump into the action are taking center stage. According to reports from gaming media outlets like IGN Games, Rockstar has scheduled the digital launch of GTA 6 for midnight local time in most countries on November 19.

While this rollout ensures that players worldwide can experience the launch as the clock strikes twelve in their respective regions, it has also sparked a very familiar and opportunistic plan among the global gaming community.

## The Classic 'New Zealand Trick' Returns

For years, console players have utilized a well-known timezone trick to bypass standard release schedules: changing their console region settings to New Zealand. Because of how time zones work, New Zealand is among the first to welcome any given calendar day.

With November 19 locked in as the midnight release date, fans online are already discussing dusting off this classic strategy. It comes as no surprise that enthusiastic players are planning to adjust their console regions just to squeeze out a few extra hours of gameplay ahead of the official local launch in their actual home countries.

## Editor's Take

Planning to shift console locations to New Zealand has become an almost ritualistic tradition for major game launches. While it remains to be seen how server checks will handle these regional shifts on launch day, the enthusiasm highlights just how eager the community is for GTA 6. It's a fun testament to the global excitement surrounding Rockstar's next masterpiece.
